cohort: 139 pregnant women receiving care at the Himalayan Institute of Medical Sciences, India, between January 2021 and December 2023.
finding: Elevated second-trimester NT-proBNP levels are associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preterm delivery, caesarean section, and low birth weight, in preeclamptic patients.
mod_finding: Elevated NT-proBNP levels showed a moderate correlation with caesarean delivery (p = 0.361).
